commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for todo, deadline, event
commitResults.messageBody:
Added child classes "TodoItem", "DeadlineItem", "EventItem" of
"ListItem".
All ListItems now also print an icon corresponding to what
sort of item it is.

*Misc: Change the way messages are printed. They are now printed in the
switch statement, making things easier to read.
Create exception class "OrangutanException" to help error handling.

There is now only one try/except block instead of many.
Also fixed some error messages not printing properly.

Add exception message for mark, unmark or delete on empty list
Fix OrangutanException such that printing exception messages no longer
prints the exception name

commitResults.messageTitle: Minor changes to ensure code complies with JCS.

commitResults.messageBody:
Previously ChatList could only be initialized with an empty list.
The new constructor allows initializing from an existing ArrayList,
allowing us to create a new ChatList from a saved file.

To facilitate this, the list attribute is changed from an inline
declaration to declaration in constructor (this applies to the
no-parameters constructor as well)

Previously, these three were subclasses of ListItem.
However this will cause problems in the future when we try to
convert each line in the save file to a ListItem subclass.
This is because doing so would require a utility class that
decides which subclass the line should be converted to.

To simplify things, let's
* merge the three subclasses back into the parent ListItem class
* update ListItem to store information on which item type
(event, deadline, todo) it belongs to

commitResults.messageTitle: Allow chat to store and load list to/from file
commitResults.messageBody:
Orangutan bot now stores the list to data/orangutan.txt
On new session, it also loads any pre-existing data from data/orangutan.txt

.gitignore: set to ignore /data/ folder

commitResults.messageTitle: Allow Orangutan to parse dates and times.
commitResults.messageBody:
Previously date and time fields were treated as strings
with no special meaning.

Now they are stored as dates and times, to allow for greater
functionality in the future (e.g. filtering for missed deadlines)

Previously Orangutan.Main() handled everything from parsing commands to
file actions and UI.

Separated commands, file actions and UI into separate classes for better
OOP.

OrangutanContext class added to pass necessary information to command
classes.

Previously all classes were in a single directory and no packages.

Let's organize them so that all of them are a package.

Originally OrangutanParser was in the Orangutan package,
but it should not be, because it handles the calling of commands from
String inputs.

Let's move OrangutanParser to the Orangutan.Command package.

commitResults.messageBody: Most of these pertain to import ordering.

After a refactor changed the case of the directories,
Some files somehow remained in a directory matching the original name.
These files are not removed.

Previously, many classes that were directly tied to Orangutan
had an "Orangutan" prefix in their names, which was cumbersome.

Furthermore, following reorganization of everything into the
orangutan package, this naming convention is unnecessary.

Remove the "Orangutan" prefix from all such classes (with the exceptions
of Orangutan and OrangutanException, of course).
